title: THE KEY LIST AND THE CARD NAME THE GUN KEYS
why: The controls list (F1) still said the 1 to 9 keys were just guns. It now says there is a gun for each kind, set in the stash, and the What is New card leads with the gun keys: every kind of gun has its own key, 1 pistol, 2 SMG, 3 rifle, 4 carbine, 5 LMG, 6 shotgun, 7 marksman, 8 sniper, 9 energy, and they can be set in the stash. The card was stamped v26.31 and is stamped with this build now.
now: The controls list and the What is New card now name the gun keys.
